infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Civic Track requires camera access to photograph civic issues such as potholes, road damage, and garbage for AI analysis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Camera access requires microphone permission on this device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Civic Track uses your location to accurately pin civic complaints on the map.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Civic Track needs photo library access to upload existing images of civic issues.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Civic Track to access your camera to photograph road damage, potholes, and garbage for AI detection.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Civic Track to access your location to pin civic complaints accurately on the map.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Civic Track to access your photos to upload existing civic issue images.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Civic Track to access your camera for photo capture.
